# ActiveWorkspace

ActiveWorkspace is the active-play side of the unified Universal system. It contains character creation, saved characters, session records, clocks, a dice console, the live generated-content compendium, and the preserved campaign-suite engine workspace.

## Start
Open `index.html`. For cross-folder live synchronization, serve the parent `AI-Brain` folder with any static server and open `ActiveWorkspace/index.html`. Direct opening still supports local character/session work.

## Authority
The canonical JSON copied into `data/architect/` is from Architect Engine v1.4. The former campaign-suite catalogs remain compatibility/import sources only.
